name: Workshop Command Center
actions: run an explicit deterministic exact-candidate technical check
run one bounded batch of server-selected unchecked technical checks
retire an exact draft only when sealed source or candidate evidence proves that copy is permanently stale or invalid
prioritize machine-approved drafts for Mike and separate machine-held drafts that need repair
cast an attributed exact-digest steward vote only after machine approval
review heartbeat code drafts only after a reasoned technical check and plain explanation
pause continue finish or cancel a saved direction
open one of five parent workspaces
route to Device Handoff with one explicit QR-session request
open the Presentation Spine migration lab
summary: A beginner-first one-page cockpit above the Workshop for planning, bounded technical checks, a prioritized ready-for-Mike queue, non-actionable repair holds, plain-language exact-digest stewardship, lifecycle control, health, evidence, creation handoffs, and navigation.
notes: Presentation and explicit request surface only. Chroma and Phone Drop are navigation routes: Chroma owns image work and Device Handoff owns the gated LAN listener. This deck gains no filesystem or network authority.
